howToPlay: Plan the perfect heist — crack the vault, dodge guards, and escape with the loot in this stealth puzzler.
about: A short choose-your-path comedy from the Henry Stickmin collection: you are trying to break into a bank vault, and every option is either genius or disastrous. Only one plan per scene works — the rest end in instant failure screens. The fun is in watching the wrong choices explode, so try everything.

title: Big Tower Tiny Square

howToPlay: A super-hard precision platformer. Navigate a tiny square through a massive tower of traps.

Spikes, swinging hammers and teleporting hazards are tuned to punish even a pixel of sloppy movement. Learn each section's rhythm instead of rushing — deaths are instant, checkpoints are generous, and the tower never changes.

howToPlay: Angle and power your cannon shots to sink basketball after basketball into the hoop. Physics-based fun.
about: Puzzle levels where you fire basketballs from a cannon and must land a set number of balls in the hoop. Angles matter more than power: bank shots off walls are often the intended solution, and most levels hide a trick — teleporters, moving platforms, or blocks to break first.

title: Cell Machine

howToPlay: Design and build self-replicating cellular automata machines. An endlessly surprising sandbox.
about: Build contraptions out of cells that spawn, move and replicate themselves to complete each level's goal. It is a friendly intro to cellular automata — start by copying the demo machines, then experiment: a single extra destroyer cell can unravel your whole build. There is no time pressure, so iterate freely.

title: Chrome Dino

howToPlay: The classic infinite runner hidden in Chrome's offline page. Jump over cacti and duck under pterodactyls.
about: The offline dinosaur runner from Chrome, playable full-screen: press space to jump cacti, duck under pterodactyls, and survive as the world speeds up. The trick to long runs is rhythm — jump on the beat of the cacti pattern rather than when panic says so, and duck-jump late birds.

title: circlO

howToPlay: A minimalist reflex game where you tap to switch a small circle's rotation direction, dodging obstacles.
about: Tap to flip the rotation of a small circle orbiting the screen, threading gaps between obstacles to collect what they drop. It is pure reflex timing: short taps make micro-adjustments, and staying near the center of a gap beats hugging its edge. Mistakes compound fast, so reset your rhythm after any hit.

title: Connect 3

howToPlay: Drop tokens to line up three in a row before your opponent does. A quicker twist on the classic Connect Four.
about: A sped-up take on Connect Four — drop tokens into the grid and be the first to line up three in a row. With the shorter win condition, the center column is even more valuable, and most games are decided by the classic double-threat: build two lines that share one empty spot.

title: CraftMine

howToPlay: Mine blocks and craft tools in this browser-based Minecraft-inspired survival sandbox Hit the gas, dodge obstacles, .
about: A browser-based survival sandbox in the Minecraft mold: punch trees, mine stone and ores, then turn raw blocks into better tools at the crafting bench. Follow the classic progression — wooden pick, stone pick, then shelter before your first night — and never dig straight down; gravity and lava are both patient.

title: CS:GO Clicker

howToPlay: An idle clicker themed around Counter-Strike. Buy guns, earn kills, and upgrade your arsenal.
about: An idle clicker with Counter-Strike flavor: click to fire, earn kills, and buy increasingly powerful guns that raise your damage per click. The progression loop is buy, outgrow the current round, repeat — prioritize upgrades that add passive income so kills keep flowing while you read the shop.

title: Cut the Rope
description: Cut the ropes at just the right moment to feed candy to the adorable little monster, Om Nom! Supports keyboard and touch controls. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Cut the ropes at just the right moment to feed candy to the adorable little monster, Om Nom!
about: Cut the Rope: cut ropes in the right order to swing a piece of candy into Om Nom's mouth, collecting stars along the way. Physics is everything — momentum from one swing should feed the next cut, and bubbles, spikes and air cushions turn later levels into little Rube Goldberg puzzles.

title: Cut the Rope Holiday
description: Om Nom's favorite puzzle game gets a festive winter makeover with new holiday-themed levels. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Om Nom's favorite puzzle game gets a festive winter makeover with new holiday-themed levels.
about: Cut the Rope's Christmas edition: the same rope-cutting physics wrapped in festive levels with new gadgets — rockets and Christmas stockings that store and launch candy. Plan the whole candy route before the first cut; rushing usually wastes your one good swing.

title: Cut the Rope Time Travel
description: Om Nom travels through history! Cut ropes across ancient Egypt, medieval castles, and prehistoric jungles. Supports keyboard and touch controls.
howToPlay: Om Nom travels through history! Cut ropes across ancient Egypt, medieval castles, and prehistoric jungles.
about: Cut the Rope Time Travel sends Om Nom and his ancestors through history, from the Stone Age to the future. Each era adds a second mouth to feed, which means one candy must do double duty. Watch how chains and rockets interact before cutting; most levels hinge on one perfectly timed slash.

title: Cupcake 2048
description: The 2048 slide puzzle re-skinned with delicious cupcakes. Merge matching treats to reach the ultimate dessert. Supports keyboard and touch controls.
howToPlay: The 2048 slide puzzle re-skinned with delicious cupcakes. Merge matching treats to reach the ultimate dessert.
about: The bakery-themed 2048: slide cupcakes, and matching kinds merge into the next size up. Strategy is identical to the classic — pin your biggest cupcake in a corner and never build toward it — but the ladder of pastry tiers makes chains much easier to read than raw numbers.

title: Deal or No Deal
description: Open briefcases and negotiate with the banker to win the most money in this TV game show classic. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Open briefcases and negotiate with the banker to win the most money in this TV game show classic.
about: Pick one of 26 briefcases, then open the rest while the banker calls in lowball offers. The math is simple expected value: compare each offer to the average of the remaining case values, and never swap at the end unless you enjoy coin flips. The drama is pretending the decision is harder than it is.

title: Death Run 3D

howToPlay: Sprint through an endless 3D tunnel of spinning blades and moving obstacles. React fast or die instantly.
about: A first-person take on the endless runner: sprint down a neon corridor, dodge blocks, and survive as the speed climbs. Look two obstacles ahead rather than at your feet, and use small strafes — wide swings at this speed are how runs end.

title: Defend the Tank

howToPlay: Position your troops and shoot down enemy waves before they destroy your precious tank.
about: Place troops around your tank and hold off waves of attackers coming from every direction. Positioning wins: put cheap blockers where the enemy funnels in and your damage dealers behind them, and save your special abilities for the waves that actually leak through.

title: Doge 2048

howToPlay: Wow. Such merge. A 2048 clone featuring the famous Doge meme. Very numbers. Much slide. So win.
about: 2048 with Shiba Inu meme tiers instead of numbers — every merge evolves the doge toward its legendary final form. Because the tiles read as faces rather than values, trust position over intuition: corner-lock the biggest doge and run a snake pattern with the smaller ones.

title: Doodle Jump
description: Guide the Doodler ever upward on randomized platforms while avoiding monsters and bottomless gaps. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Guide the Doodler ever upward on randomized platforms while avoiding monsters and bottomless gaps.
about: Bounce a four-legged doodle ever upward, steering between platforms while dodging monsters, UFOs and black holes. Springs and propellers buy big altitude — the key skill is reading platform types ahead: brown platforms break, blue ones move, white ones crumble after one bounce.

title: Draw the Hill

howToPlay: Draw a road with your finger and watch your car drive across it. Simple physics, endlessly creative.
about: Draw a road with your finger or mouse and the car drives across whatever line you made. The trick is smooth gradients: steep lines stall the engine, while long descending curves build speed for jumps. Coins reward routes that use momentum instead of scribbled bridges.

title: Edge Not Found

howToPlay: Navigate the Chrome dinosaur into a web-themed adventure of missing pages and 404 errors.
about: The Chrome dinosaur leaves its offline page for a web-themed adventure: run through a landscape of missing pages, 404 errors and browser quirks, jumping hazards the same one-button way. The theme changes the scenery, not the physics — small early jumps, read the terrain a beat ahead, and let the constant speed do the steering.

title: Endless War 3
description: Command infantry, tanks, and air support across brutal World War II-inspired battlefields. Controlled entirely with your keyboard. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Command infantry, tanks, and air support across brutal World War II-inspired battlefields.
about: A top-down WWII shooter with destructible cover, drivable vehicles and dozens of missions. Keep moving between sandbag positions — standing still invites grenades — and capture enemy machine guns whenever the map offers one; they shred incoming waves.

title: Evil Glitch
description: A glitchy platformer where the game itself fights back — tiles disappear, colors invert, and the rules break. Supports keyboard and touch controls.
howToPlay: A glitchy platformer where the game itself fights back — tiles disappear, colors invert, and the rules break.
about: A retro platformer where the game itself glitches against you: tiles vanish, colors invert mid-jump, and the rules break on purpose. Treat every failed run as data — the glitches follow patterns, and surviving means learning them rather than reacting. Precision beats speed.

title: Flappy Bird
description: Tap to keep the bird airborne through narrow gaps in the pipes. One tap at a time. Runs in any modern browser on mobile and desktop. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Tap to keep the bird airborne through narrow gaps in the pipes. One tap at a time.
about: Tap to flap between green pipe gaps in the notoriously unforgiving one-button classic. The bird's physics are floaty, so small, early taps beat big corrections — aim for the middle of each gap and keep your tap rhythm steady instead of chasing the exact center.

title: Geometry Dash (Scratch)
description: Rhythm-based action platformer. Jump, fly, and flip through increasingly dangerous levels. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Runs in any modern browser o.
howToPlay: Rhythm-based action platformer. Jump, fly, and flip through increasingly dangerous levels.
about: A Scratch-built version of Geometry Dash: one button controls everything as an auto-running cube leaps spikes, flies through portals, and dies instantly on any mistake. Memorization is the mechanic — learn the level in chunks, and do not change your timing between attempts.

title: Getaway Shootout
description: Race your opponent to the getaway vehicle using wild leaps and power-ups. Fast chaotic fun. Controlled entirely with your keyboard. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Race your opponent to the getaway vehicle using wild leaps and power-ups. Fast chaotic fun.
about: Two criminals race to the getaway vehicle using only jump and shoot — no walking. The weapon pickups are deliberately absurd, and the trick to most maps is controlling the high ground; shooting the obstacle blocking the shortcut you cannot reach yet often opens it.

title: Gimme the Airpod

howToPlay: Quick physics puzzles where you maneuver to grab the missing AirPod from increasingly tricky situations.

howToPlay: An idle crafting incremental: combine resources, build machines, and work your way up from stone to steel.
about: A Minecraft-themed idle game where you grind resources and follow the crafting tree from wooden picks to nether gear. Keep every worker slot busy — villagers mine while you click — and prioritize food and tool upgrades in that order; the wood-to-iron bottleneck is where most players stall.

title: Helicopter
description: Steer the helicopter through tight caves by holding the mouse button. A deceptively simple classic. Runs in any modern browser on mobile and desktop.
howToPlay: Steer the helicopter through tight caves by holding the mouse button. A deceptively simple classic.
about: The classic cave-flyer: hold to rise, release to fall, and thread the helicopter through an ever-narrowing cave. Gravity is constant and jerkiness is death — the winning style is long, gentle hover adjustments, planning your line two obstacles ahead instead of dodging each one.

title: HexGL
description: A futuristic high-speed racing game inspired by F-Zero and WipeOut, running entirely in WebGL. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: A futuristic high-speed racing game inspired by F-Zero and WipeOut, running entirely in WebGL.
about: A WebGL futuristic racer in the spirit of F-Zero: airbrake through banked corners, ride the boost strips, and keep your ship off the walls. Airbraking before the turn apex — not during — is the difference between a clean line and scraping the barrier.

title: Interactive Buddy
description: A physics sandbox where you interact with a squishy buddy — throw it, bounce it, and apply ragdoll chaos. Supports keyboard and touch controls.
howToPlay: A physics sandbox where you interact with a squishy buddy — throw it, bounce it, and apply ragdoll chaos.
about: A physics sandbox starring a ragdoll you can pummel with baseball bats, grenades, fire hoses and rockets. Cash earned from each hit unlocks new weapons and skins. There is no fail state — the fun is chaining explosions and watching the indestructible buddy ragdoll across the room.

title: Just One Boss
description: You only have one boss to fight — but it has many phases. A challenging bullet-hell boss rush game. Controlled entirely with your keyboard. Play free online.
howToPlay: You only have one boss to fight — but it has many phases. A challenging bullet-hell boss rush game.
about: A minimalist bullet-hell boss rush: one screen, one boss, dozens of attack phases, and instant death on contact. Every phase teaches a dodge pattern — learn the tells, then re-run with confidence. It is short but punishing; the final phase is fair, just fast.

title: Krunker
description: A fast-paced browser-based FPS with blocky graphics and silky-smooth gunplay. No download needed. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: A fast-paced browser-based FPS with blocky graphics and silky-smooth gunplay.
about: A fast browser FPS with Counter-Strike-style movement: bunny-hop, slide and flick with low input latency across classic modes and custom maps. Movement is the skill ceiling — slide-hopping makes you nearly unhittable, and learning one map's sightlines beats changing loadouts.

title: Meme 2048
description: The sliding tile puzzle with a meme twist — merge your favorite internet icons instead of plain numbers. Supports keyboard and touch controls.
howToPlay: The sliding tile puzzle with a meme twist — merge your favorite internet icons instead of plain numbers.
about: 2048 reskinned with internet meme faces as tiles — merge tiers until you assemble the final meme. The strategy is the same corner-lock approach as the original; the joke tiles actually help you spot merge chains faster than plain numbers do.

title: Eaglercraft
description: Play Minecraft 1.8 directly in your browser with no Java, no downloads, and no plugins required. Controlled entirely with your keyboard. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Play Minecraft 1.8 directly in your browser.
about: Eaglercraft: the full Minecraft experience running in a browser — mine, craft, build and survive creepers in a procedurally generated world, single player or on servers. It is a faithful 1.5.2 build, so the classic opening holds: punch wood, craft tools, light your base before nightfall.

title: Minesweeper
description: The classic Windows game. Use logic to flag mines and reveal safe squares without triggering an explosion. Supports keyboard and touch controls.
howToPlay: The classic Windows game. Use logic to flag mines and reveal safe squares without triggering an explosion.
about: The classic logic puzzle: numbers tell you how many of the eight surrounding cells hide mines, and deduction — not luck — clears the board. Look for the 1-2-1 and 1-2-2-1 patterns, flag only when certain, and guess only when the math leaves no alternative.

title: Mini-putt
description: Play miniature golf across quirky, physics-driven courses. Master angles and power to sink every hole. Supports keyboard and touch controls.
howToPlay: Play miniature golf across quirky, physics-driven courses. Master angles and power to sink every hole.
about: Miniature golf with clean physics: read the slope, set the power, and sink putts under par. Bank shots off walls are more reliable than straight lines on most holes, and gentle taps on downhill greens beat firm ones — the ball breaks more than your eye says.

title: Missiles
description: Intercept incoming missiles before they destroy your cities. A browser remake of the arcade classic. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Play free online.
howToPlay: Intercept incoming missiles before they destroy your cities. A browser remake of the arcade classic.
about: Pilot an aircraft while a storm of homing missiles chases you: lure them into each other, dodge terrain, and grab pickups to turn defense into offense. The core skill is herding — fly wide circles so missile clusters bunch up, then break the pattern at the last second.

title: n-gon
description: A minimal but brutally difficult dodging game. Navigate an n-sided polygon through a barrage of threats. Controlled entirely with your keyboard.
howToPlay: A minimal but brutally difficult dodging game. Navigate an n-sided polygon through a barrage of threats.
about: A minimalist but punishing arena survival: steer an n-sided polygon through waves of spinning blades, homing shapes and bullets while collecting upgrades. Movement is inertia-based, so small corrections early prevent oversteering; prioritize shields before firepower.

title: Om Nom Bounce
description: Help Om Nom bounce on trampolines to gobble up candy high in the air. Timing-based physics fun. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Help Om Nom bounce on trampolines to gobble up candy high in the air. Timing-based physics fun.
about: Om Nom bounces between trampolines to reach candy floating high out of reach. Each trampoline stretches under him and springs him higher the deeper it compresses, so timing the bounce — not tapping faster — is the whole game. Line up the next jump while mid-air, and let big drops build the height you need.

title: Papaspizzaria
description: Run Papa's Pizzeria: take orders, prep dough, add toppings, bake, and serve to hungry customers. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Free to play instantly.
howToPlay: Run Papa's Pizzeria: take orders, prep dough, add toppings, bake, and serve to hungry customers.
about: Papa's Pizzeria: take orders, top pizzas, bake and slice to order while customers wait. The station-hopping time pressure is the game — start baking as soon as toppings are on, and cut into the exact portions ordered; sloppy slices cost as much as burnt crusts.

title: Paper.io 2
description: Expand your territory by drawing loops on the paper grid — but watch your back; rivals will cut your line. Supports keyboard and touch controls.
howToPlay: Expand your territory by drawing loops on the paper grid — but watch your back; rivals will cut your line.
about: Claim territory in Paper.io 2: loop out of your color, enclose land, and return before anyone cuts your tail. Small loops beat greedy ones early — the players who die are the ones circling for one more chunk. Turning inside your own color is always safe.

title: Papery Planes
description: Fold and fly paper planes through tricky courses. Adjust lift, weight, and angle to glide perfectly. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Play free online.
howToPlay: Fold and fly paper planes through tricky courses. Adjust lift, weight, and angle to glide perfectly.
about: Fold a paper plane and glide it through tricky courses, adjusting lift, weight and angle as you fly. Nose up to climb and bleed speed, nose down to dive and trade height for distance — the best runs ride that trade deliberately instead of fighting it. Watch for updrafts on the course line and use them to recover altitude for free.

title: Push The Square
description: Guide a square to its target by placing directional arrows on the grid to steer it through puzzles. Supports keyboard and touch controls. Play free online.
howToPlay: Guide a square to its target by placing directional arrows on the grid to steer it through puzzles.
about: A grid puzzle about steering a square with placed arrow tiles: the square follows your arrows to the goal, but the grid fills up and careless placements block later paths. Work backwards from the goal — the last two moves constrain everything before them.

title: Rolly Vortex
description: Roll a ball through a spinning tube full of obstacles. Tilt, dodge, and keep rolling as far as you can. Supports keyboard and touch controls.
howToPlay: Roll a ball through a spinning tube full of obstacles. Tilt, dodge, and keep rolling as far as you can.
about: Rotate a ring around a falling ball, dodging spikes and gaps in an endless descending vortex. The screen scrolls at a fixed pace, so panic-rotations overshoot — short, rhythmic flicks keep the gap aligned, and gems are only worth grabbing on clear stretches.

title: Snow Battle
description: Throw snowballs at opponents in this winter multiplayer brawl. Build cover and eliminate your rivals. Controlled entirely with your keyboard.
